+"""Concern 3 analysis -> revision/results/c3/summary.json and tables.md.
+
+Checks: S1 (model-free reruns = rev3_load.jsonl), I2 (M0 GNN reruns vs rev3_load.jsonl, informational),
+S2 (instrumented = uninstrumented on decisions and drops), S3 (no errors, packet conservation, drop split),
+S4 (oracle reruns at load 1.0 = rev4_c1.jsonl). Routing: per-load means, % vs ECMP, route changes, reordering;
+paired differences in % of the mean ECMP drops with pair and family-clustered bootstrap CIs (rev5_stats.compare:
+2,000 draws, seed 42); model variants averaged over the three training seeds per (family, seed) cell. At a load
+whose ECMP drops are 0 the differences are reported in packets. Findings (a) forecaster and (b) guard effectiveness
+are kept in separate sections."""
+import json, os, sys
+from collections import defaultdict
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import c3_common as C
+import numpy as np
+import rev5_stats
+
+R3 = os.path.join(C.ROOT, 'revision', 'results')
+KEEP = ['total_drops', 'fabric_link_drops', 'host_link_drops', 'total_offered', 'total_delivered',
+        'delivered_mean_latency_us', 'delivered_p99_latency_us', 'reroutes']
+C1_KEEP = KEEP + ['reordered_packets', 'reordered_fraction', 'flows_with_reordering', 'n_flows']
+MODEL_FREE = ['ecmp', 'guarded_score', 'score_no_rules', 'random']
+LABEL = {'ecmp': 'ECMP', 'guarded_score': 'score/0.851', 'score_pmix': 'score/Pmix', 'guarded_gnn': 'M0/P1.0',
+         'm0p_p10': "M0'/P1.0", 'm1_pmix': 'M1/Pmix', 'score_no_rules': 'score, no rules', 'random': 'random/0.851',
+         'm1_p10': 'M1/P1.0', 'm0_pmix': 'M0/Pmix', 'm0p_pmix': "M0'/Pmix", 'oracle_label': 'oracle label/0.5',
+         'oracle_score_pmix': 'oracle score/Pmix', 'oracle_score_0851': 'oracle score/0.851'}
+COMPARISONS = [  # (name, a, b, section)
+    ('PRIMARY M1/Pmix - score/Pmix', 'm1_pmix', 'score_pmix', 'a'),
+    ("M1/Pmix - M0'/P1.0 (mixed-training effect, same environment)", 'm1_pmix', 'm0p_p10', 'a'),
+    ("M0'/P1.0 - score/0.851 (same-environment replicate)", 'm0p_p10', 'guarded_score', 'a'),
+    ('M0/P1.0 - score/0.851 (original checkpoints)', 'guarded_gnn', 'guarded_score', 'a'),
+    ('M1/Pmix - M0/P1.0', 'm1_pmix', 'guarded_gnn', 'a'),
+    ('score/Pmix - score/0.851 (threshold effect, score)', 'score_pmix', 'guarded_score', 'a'),
+    ("M1/P1.0 - M0'/P1.0 (model effect at P1.0)", 'm1_p10', 'm0p_p10', 'a2'),
+    ("M1/Pmix - M0'/Pmix (model effect at Pmix)", 'm1_pmix', 'm0p_pmix', 'a2'),
+    ('M1/Pmix - M1/P1.0 (threshold effect, M1)', 'm1_pmix', 'm1_p10', 'a2'),
+    ("M0'/Pmix - M0'/P1.0 (threshold effect, M0')", 'm0p_pmix', 'm0p_p10', 'a2'),
+    ('M0/Pmix - M0/P1.0 (threshold effect, M0)', 'm0_pmix', 'guarded_gnn', 'a2'),
+    ('score/0.851 - ECMP', 'guarded_score', 'ecmp', 'b'),
+    ('score/Pmix - ECMP', 'score_pmix', 'ecmp', 'b'),
+    ('score, no rules - ECMP', 'score_no_rules', 'ecmp', 'b'),
+    ('random/0.851 - ECMP', 'random', 'ecmp', 'b'),
+]
+ORACLE_COMPARISONS = [
+    ('oracle label - score/Pmix', 'oracle_label', 'score_pmix'), ('oracle score/Pmix - score/Pmix', 'oracle_score_pmix', 'score_pmix'),
+    ('oracle score/0.851 - score/0.851', 'oracle_score_0851', 'guarded_score'),
+    ('oracle label - ECMP', 'oracle_label', 'ecmp'), ('oracle score/Pmix - ECMP', 'oracle_score_pmix', 'ecmp'),
+    ('oracle score/0.851 - ECMP', 'oracle_score_0851', 'ecmp'),
+    ('oracle label - M1/Pmix', 'oracle_label', 'm1_pmix'), ('oracle score/Pmix - M1/Pmix', 'oracle_score_pmix', 'm1_pmix'),
+]
+
+
+def jl(path):
+    return [json.loads(l) for l in open(path)] if os.path.exists(path) else []
+
+
+def jload(name):
+    p = os.path.join(C.OUT, name)
+    return json.load(open(p)) if os.path.exists(p) else None
+
+
+def cells(rows):
+    """variant -> load -> (family, seed) -> row (numeric fields averaged over training seeds)."""
+    g = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list)))
+    for r in rows:
+        g[r['variant']][r['load']][(r['family'], r['seed'])].append(r)
+    out = {}
+    for v, d in g.items():
+        out[v] = {}
+        for lf, cs in d.items():
+            out[v][lf] = {}
+            for c, rs in cs.items():
+                avg = {k: float(np.mean([x[k] for x in rs])) for k in KEEP + ['reordered_packets', 'flows_with_reordering']
+                       if all(x.get(k) is not None for x in rs)}
+                avg['n_seeds'] = len(rs)
+                out[v][lf][c] = avg
+    return out
+
+
+def diff(A, B, E):
+    """paired A - B over common (family, seed) cells."""
+    common = sorted(set(A) & set(B))
+    if not common:
+        return None
+    if E > 0:
+        r = rev5_stats.compare({k: A[k] for k in common}, {k: B[k] for k in common}, E)
+        r['unit'] = '% of mean ECMP drops'
+        return r
+    d = {k: A[k]['total_drops'] - B[k]['total_drops'] for k in common}
+    pb, cb = rev5_stats.boot(d), rev5_stats.boot(d, cluster=True)
+    return dict(n=len(common), mean=float(np.mean(list(d.values()))), unit='packets (ECMP drops are 0)',
+                ci95_pkts=np.percentile(pb, [2.5, 97.5]).round(3).tolist(),
+                ci95_cluster_pkts=np.percentile(cb, [2.5, 97.5]).round(3).tolist(),
+                wins=int(sum(v < 0 for v in d.values())), ties=int(sum(v == 0 for v in d.values())),
+                losses=int(sum(v > 0 for v in d.values())))
+
+
+def checks(load_rows, oracle_rows):
+    rev3 = {r['id']: r for r in jl(os.path.join(R3, 'rev3_load.jsonl'))}
+    out = {}
+    # S3
+    allrows = load_rows + oracle_rows
+    errs = [r['id'] for r in allrows if 'error' in r]
+    bad = [r['id'] for r in allrows if 'error' not in r and not (r['packet_conservation'] and r['drop_split_ok'])]
+    out['S3'] = dict(ok=not errs and not bad, rows=len(allrows), errors=errs[:20], invariant_failures=bad[:20])
+    ok_rows = [r for r in load_rows if 'error' not in r]
+    # S1
+    mf = [r for r in ok_rows if r['variant'] in MODEL_FREE]
+    mism = [r['id'] for r in mf if r['id'] not in rev3 or any(r[k] != rev3[r['id']][k] for k in KEEP)]
+    out['S1'] = dict(ok=bool(mf) and not mism, compared=len(mf), mismatches=mism[:20], n_mismatch=len(mism))
+    # I2
+    gg = [r for r in ok_rows if r['variant'] == 'guarded_gnn' and r['id'] in rev3]
+    dd = [r['total_drops'] - rev3[r['id']]['total_drops'] for r in gg]
+    neq = [r for r in gg if any(r[k] != rev3[r['id']][k] for k in KEEP)]
+    out['I2'] = dict(compared=len(gg), identical=len(gg) - len(neq), differing=len(neq),
+                     max_abs_total_drops_diff=float(max(map(abs, dd))) if dd else None,
+                     mean_total_drops_diff=float(np.mean(dd)) if dd else None,
+                     reroutes_diff_rows=int(sum(r['reroutes'] != rev3[r['id']]['reroutes'] for r in gg)))
+    # S2
+    plain = {r['id']: r for r in jl(os.path.join(C.OUT, 'instrument_check_plain.jsonl')) if 'error' not in r}
+    inst = {r['id']: r for r in ok_rows}
+    fields = KEEP + ['decision_digest', 'signal_digest']
+    s2 = [i for i in plain if i in inst and any(plain[i].get(k) != inst[i].get(k) for k in fields)]
+    out['S2'] = dict(ok=bool(plain) and all(i in inst for i in plain) and not s2, compared=len(plain), mismatches=s2)
+    # S4
+    c1 = {r['id']: r for r in jl(os.path.join(R3, 'rev4_c1.jsonl'))}
+    rep = [r for r in jl(os.path.join(C.OUT, 'oracle_repro.jsonl')) if 'error' not in r]
+    name = {'oracle_label': 'oracle_label', 'oracle_score_0851': 'oracle_score'}
+    s4 = []
+    for r in rep:
+        ref = c1.get(f"exact|{name[r['variant']]}|None|{r['family']}|{r['seed']}")
+        if ref is None or any(r[k] != ref[k] for k in C1_KEEP):
+            s4.append(r['id'])
+    out['S4'] = dict(ok=bool(rep) and not s4, compared=len(rep), mismatches=s4)
+    return out
+
+
+def fmt_ci(x):
+    if x is None:
+        return 'not run'
+    if 'mean_pct' in x:
+        return f"{x['mean_pct']:+.2f} [{x['ci95_pct'][0]:+.2f}, {x['ci95_pct'][1]:+.2f}] / [{x['ci95_cluster_pct'][0]:+.2f}, {x['ci95_cluster_pct'][1]:+.2f}]"
+    return f"{x['mean']:+.1f} pkts [{x['ci95_pkts'][0]:+.1f}, {x['ci95_pkts'][1]:+.1f}] / [{x['ci95_cluster_pkts'][0]:+.1f}, {x['ci95_cluster_pkts'][1]:+.1f}]"
+
+
+def main():
+    load_rows = jl(os.path.join(C.OUT, 'load.jsonl'))
+    oracle_rows = jl(os.path.join(C.OUT, 'oracle.jsonl'))
+    S = dict(meta=C.meta(step='analyze'), checks=checks(load_rows, oracle_rows))
+    good = [r for r in load_rows if 'error' not in r]
+    cl = cells(good)
+    ocl = cells([r for r in oracle_rows if 'error' not in r])
+    S['variants_run'] = {v: {str(lf): len(cs) for lf, cs in d.items()} for v, d in cl.items()}
+    routing = {}
+    for lf in C.LOADS:
+        e = cl.get('ecmp', {}).get(lf)
+        if not e:
+            continue
+        E = float(np.mean([x['total_drops'] for x in e.values()]))
+        blk = dict(ecmp_mean_drops=E, ecmp_loss_pct=float(sum(x['total_drops'] for x in e.values()) /
+                                                          sum(x['total_offered'] for x in e.values()) * 100), variants={}, diffs={})
+        for v, d in cl.items():
+            c = d.get(lf)
+            if not c:
+                continue
+            D = float(np.mean([x['total_drops'] for x in c.values()]))
+            blk['variants'][v] = dict(
+                cells=len(c), mean_drops=D, total_pct_vs_ecmp=(D / E - 1) * 100 if E > 0 else None,
+                reroutes=float(np.mean([x['reroutes'] for x in c.values()])),
+                reordered_pct=float(sum(x.get('reordered_packets', 0) for x in c.values()) / sum(x['total_delivered'] for x in c.values()) * 100),
+                p99_ms=float(np.mean([x['delivered_p99_latency_us'] for x in c.values()]) / 1000))
+        for name, a, b, sec in COMPARISONS:
+            A, B = cl.get(a, {}).get(lf), cl.get(b, {}).get(lf)
+            blk['diffs'][name] = dict(section=sec, result=diff(A, B, E) if A and B else None)
+        routing[str(lf)] = blk
+    # aggregate over all loads: per base scenario, drops summed over the loads
+    agg = {}
+    def summed(v):
+        d = cl.get(v)
+        if not d or set(d) != set(C.LOADS):
+            return None
+        keys = set.intersection(*(set(d[lf]) for lf in C.LOADS))
+        return {k: dict(total_drops=sum(d[lf][k]['total_drops'] for lf in C.LOADS)) for k in keys}
+    E_all = summed('ecmp')
+    if E_all:
+        Em = float(np.mean([x['total_drops'] for x in E_all.values()]))
+        for name, a, b, sec in COMPARISONS:
+            A, B = summed(a), summed(b)
+            agg[name] = dict(section=sec, result=diff(A, B, Em) if A and B else None)
+    S['routing'], S['routing_all_loads'] = routing, agg
+    # oracle (loads 0.2, 0.25)
+    orc = {}
+    for lf in (0.2, 0.25):
+        e = cl.get('ecmp', {}).get(lf)
+        if not e:
+            continue
+        E = float(np.mean([x['total_drops'] for x in e.values()]))
+        both = {**{v: d for v, d in cl.items()}, **{v: d for v, d in ocl.items()}}
+        blk = dict(variants={}, diffs={})
+        for v, d in ocl.items():
+            c = d.get(lf)
+            if c:
+                D = float(np.mean([x['total_drops'] for x in c.values()]))
+                blk['variants'][v] = dict(cells=len(c), families=sorted({f for f, _ in c}), mean_drops=D,
+                                          total_pct_vs_ecmp=(D / E - 1) * 100 if E > 0 else None,
+                                          reroutes=float(np.mean([x['reroutes'] for x in c.values()])),
+                                          reordered_pct=float(sum(x.get('reordered_packets', 0) for x in c.values()) /
+                                                              sum(x['total_delivered'] for x in c.values()) * 100))
+        for name, a, b in ORACLE_COMPARISONS:
+            A, B = both.get(a, {}).get(lf), both.get(b, {}).get(lf)
+            blk['diffs'][name] = diff(A, B, E) if A and B else None
+        orc[str(lf)] = blk
+    S['oracle'] = orc
+    C.write_json(os.path.join(C.OUT, 'summary.json'), S)
+    tables(S)
+    print(json.dumps(S['checks'], indent=1))
+
+
+def tables(S):
+    L = ['# Concern 3 tables (generated by c3_analyze.py)', '']
+    # forecast
+    F = jload('forecast.json')
+    if F:
+        for tset in ('unseen', 'benchmark'):
+            if tset not in F['sets']:
+                continue
+            L += [f'## Forecast — {tset} test set (AP: mean ± sd over 3 training seeds; CIs: scenario bootstrap)', '',
+                  '| load | positives | scen. w/ pos | AP M0 | AP M0′ | AP M1 | AP persistence | onset AP M0′ / M1 / pers. | Brier M0′ / M1 | flags | M1 − M0′ AP [95% CI] | M1 − persistence AP [95% CI] | onset M1 − M0′ [95% CI] |',
+                  '|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|']
+            for lf in [str(x) for x in C.LOADS] + ['pooled']:
+                b = F['sets'][tset].get(lf)
+                if b is None:
+                    continue
+                m = b['models']
+                ap = lambda n, key='ap': 'undef.' if m[n][key] is None else f"{m[n][key]['mean']:.3f} ± {m[n][key]['sd']:.3f}"
+                pa = 'undef.' if m['persistence']['ap'] is None else f"{m['persistence']['ap']:.3f}"
+                oa = lambda n: 'undef.' if m[n]['onset_ap'] is None else f"{m[n]['onset_ap']['mean']:.3f}"
+                po = 'undef.' if m['persistence']['onset_ap'] is None else f"{m['persistence']['onset_ap']:.3f}"
+                br = lambda n: '—' if m[n]['brier'] is None else f"{m[n]['brier']['mean']:.4f}"
+                flags = 'AP undefined' if b['ap_undefined'] else ('unstable' if b['unstable'] else 'ok')
+                if not b['onset_ap_undefined'] and b['onset_unstable']:
+                    flags += '; onset unstable'
+                bs = b['bootstrap']
+                ci = lambda part, c: '—' if not bs or bs[part].get(c) is None or bs[part][c]['point'] is None else \
+                    f"{bs[part][c]['point']:+.4f} [{bs[part][c]['ci95'][0]:+.4f}, {bs[part][c]['ci95'][1]:+.4f}]"
+                L.append(f"| {lf} | {b['positives']} | {b['scenarios_with_positives']}/{b['scenarios']} | {ap('M0')} | {ap('M0p')} | {ap('M1')} | {pa} | "
+                         f"{oa('M0p')} / {oa('M1')} / {po} | {br('M0p')} / {br('M1')} | {flags} | {ci('overall', 'M1-M0p')} | {ci('overall', 'M1-persistence')} | {ci('onset', 'M1-M0p')} |")
+            L.append('')
+    # routing
+    R = S['routing']
+    if R:
+        cols = ['ecmp', 'guarded_score', 'score_pmix', 'guarded_gnn', 'm0p_p10', 'm1_pmix', 'm1_p10', 'm0_pmix', 'm0p_pmix', 'score_no_rules', 'random']
+        L += ['## Routing — total drops vs ECMP (%), route changes per run, reordered packets (% of delivered)', '',
+              '| load | ECMP loss % | ' + ' | '.join(LABEL[c] for c in cols) + ' |', '|---|---|' + '---|' * len(cols)]
+        for lf, b in R.items():
+            cell = lambda c: 'not run' if c not in b['variants'] else (
+                ('n/a' if b['variants'][c]['total_pct_vs_ecmp'] is None else f"{b['variants'][c]['total_pct_vs_ecmp']:+.2f}%")
+                + f"; {b['variants'][c]['reroutes']:.1f} rc; {b['variants'][c]['reordered_pct']:.3f}% ro")
+            L.append(f"| {lf} | {b['ecmp_loss_pct']:.2f} | " + ' | '.join(cell(c) for c in cols) + ' |')
+        L += ['', '## Routing — paired differences (mean [pair 95% CI] / [family-clustered 95% CI]; negative = fewer drops than the reference)', '']
+        names = [n for n, *_ in COMPARISONS]
+        L += ['| comparison | section | ' + ' | '.join(R) + ' | all loads |', '|---|---|' + '---|' * (len(R) + 1)]
+        for n, a, b2, sec in COMPARISONS:
+            row = [fmt_ci(R[lf]['diffs'][n]['result']) for lf in R]
+            ag = S['routing_all_loads'].get(n)
+            L.append(f'| {n} | {sec} | ' + ' | '.join(row) + f" | {fmt_ci(ag['result']) if ag else 'not run'} |")
+        L.append('')
+    O = S['oracle']
+    if O:
+        L += ['## Passive oracle (loads 0.2, 0.25)', '', '| load | variant | cells | families | vs ECMP | route changes | reordered % |', '|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|']
+        for lf, b in O.items():
+            for v, x in b['variants'].items():
+                L.append(f"| {lf} | {LABEL[v]} | {x['cells']} | {len(x['families'])} | {x['total_pct_vs_ecmp']:+.2f}% | {x['reroutes']:.1f} | {x['reordered_pct']:.3f} |")
+        L += ['', '| comparison | ' + ' | '.join(O) + ' |', '|---|' + '---|' * len(O)]
+        for n, *_ in ORACLE_COMPARISONS:
+            L.append(f'| {n} | ' + ' | '.join(fmt_ci(O[lf]['diffs'].get(n)) for lf in O) + ' |')
+        L.append('')
+    path = os.path.join(C.OUT, 'tables.md')
+    C.guard_output(path)
+    open(path, 'w', encoding='utf8').write('\n'.join(L))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Concern 3 calibration protocols -> revision/results/c3/calibration.json.
+
+P1.0 = temperature + alert threshold fitted on the 6 validation base scenarios at load 1.0 (the original val set);
+Pmix = the same 6 scenarios pooled over the 8 loads. Same functions as model/train.py (predict_probabilities with
+batch 64, fit_temperature, tune_threshold on the calibrated probabilities). Score: tune_threshold on val last_scores.
+Each signal gets exactly one fit per protocol. No test data is read.
+Natural protocols (M0/P1.0, M0'/P1.0, M1/Pmix) are recomputed and must equal the values stored by training."""
+import os, sys
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import c3_common as C
+import torch
+
+from model.dataset import load_datasets
+from model.gnn_model import CongestionPredictor, load_compatible_state_dict, check_checkpoint_schema
+from model.train import predict_probabilities
+from model.calibration import fit_temperature, apply_temperature
+from model.metrics import tune_threshold
+from simulation.network_engine import NetworkEngine
+from simulation.telemetry import TelemetryCollector
+from simulation.topology import build_fat_tree
+
+MODELS = {'M0': os.path.join(C.ROOT, 'checkpoints', 'best_model_v3'), 'M0p': C.STEM_M0P, 'M1': C.STEM_M1}
+NATURAL = {'M0': 'P1.0', 'M0p': 'P1.0', 'M1': 'Pmix'}
+
+
+def fit(raw, y):
+    T = fit_temperature(raw, y)
+    return float(T), float(tune_threshold(y, apply_temperature(raw, T)))
+
+
+def main():
+    torch.set_num_threads(2)
+    _, val, _ = load_datasets(C.DATA)
+    vsets = {'P1.0': C.load_subset(val, 1.0), 'Pmix': val}
+    g = build_fat_tree()
+    col = TelemetryCollector(g, NetworkEngine(g))
+    edge_pairs = [(col.switch_to_idx[u], col.switch_to_idx[v]) for u, v in col.switch_edges]
+    rep = dict(meta=C.meta(step='calibrate'), val_windows={p: len(v) for p, v in vsets.items()}, models={}, score={})
+    ok = True
+    for name, stem in MODELS.items():
+        rep['models'][name] = {}
+        for k in C.TRAIN_SEEDS:
+            path = stem + ('' if k == 0 else f'_seed{k}') + '.pt'
+            ck = torch.load(path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
+            check_checkpoint_schema(ck)
+            m = CongestionPredictor(num_edges=len(col.switch_edges), edge_pairs=edge_pairs)
+            load_compatible_state_dict(m, ck['model_state_dict'])
+            m.eval()
+            e = {}
+            for p, vs in vsets.items():
+                T, th = fit(predict_probabilities(m, vs), vs.stacked('labels'))
+                e[p] = dict(temperature=T, threshold=th)
+            nat = e[NATURAL[name]]
+            e['natural'] = NATURAL[name]
+            e['natural_matches_checkpoint'] = (abs(nat['temperature'] - ck['temperature']) <= 1e-6 * max(1, ck['temperature'])
+                                               and abs(nat['threshold'] - ck['alert_threshold']) <= 1e-6)
+            e['checkpoint'] = dict(temperature=float(ck['temperature']), threshold=float(ck['alert_threshold']))
+            # the natural protocol always uses the values stored by training
+            e[NATURAL[name]] = dict(e['checkpoint'])
+            ok &= e['natural_matches_checkpoint']
+            rep['models'][name][str(k)] = e
+            print(name, 42 + k, {p: (round(e[p]['temperature'], 4), round(e[p]['threshold'], 4)) for p in vsets},
+                  'natural ok' if e['natural_matches_checkpoint'] else 'NATURAL MISMATCH', flush=True)
+    for p, vs in vsets.items():
+        rep['score'][p] = float(tune_threshold(vs.stacked('labels'), vs.stacked('last_scores')))
+    rep['score']['P1.0_used'] = C.SCORE_TH_P10          # the rounded value every revision script uses
+    rep['score']['Pmix_used'] = rep['score']['Pmix']
+    rep['score_P10_matches_benchmark'] = rep['score']['P1.0'] == 0.8510000109672546
+    ok &= rep['score_P10_matches_benchmark']
+    rep['ok'] = bool(ok)
+    print('score', rep['score'])
+    C.write_json(os.path.join(C.OUT, 'calibration.json'), rep)
+    sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Concern 3 (mixed-load retraining): shared constants, load scaling, output-path guard and run metadata.
+
+Protocol: revision/results/c3/PROTOCOL.md. Outputs go only to revision/results/c3/, checkpoints/c3/ and
+data/datasets_c3_mixedload.pkl. The paper's artifacts are protected by guard_output()."""
+from paths import NF_ROOT  # noqa: F401  (also puts the folder layout in place)
+import copy, hashlib, json, os, platform, subprocess, sys, time
+
+ROOT = os.environ.get('NF_ROOT', NF_ROOT)
+if ROOT not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)
+
+LOADS = [0.1, 0.125, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]          # = rev3_load.LOADS
+FAM = ['uniform', 'hotspot', 'elephant_mice', 'stride', 'llm_training', 'mixed']
+UNSEEN = list(range(4000, 4010))                                 # = rev3_load.SEEDS
+TICKS = 150
+TRAIN_SEEDS = (0, 1, 2)                                          # training seed 42 + k
+OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, 'revision', 'results', 'c3')
+CKDIR = os.path.join(ROOT, 'checkpoints', 'c3')
+DATA = os.path.join(ROOT, 'data', 'datasets_c3_mixedload.pkl')
+STEM_M0P = os.path.join(CKDIR, 'best_model_c3_load1')           # M0': load-1.0 controls, current environment
+STEM_M1 = os.path.join(CKDIR, 'best_model_c3_mixed')            # M1: mixed-load models
+SCORE_TH_P10 = 0.851                                             # score threshold used by every revision script
+UNSTABLE_MIN_POS, UNSTABLE_MIN_SCEN = 100, 5                     # unstable-AP rule (PROTOCOL.md)

+
+def scaled_flows(graph, seed, family, load, ticks=TICKS):
+    """Exactly the rev3_load.py procedure: generate, deep-copy, multiply every flow rate by `load`."""
+    from simulation.traffic_generator import TrafficGenerator
+    flows = copy.deepcopy(TrafficGenerator(graph, seed=seed).generate_scenario(total_ticks=ticks, pattern=family))
+    for f in flows:
+        f.rate *= load
+    return flows
+
+
+def _norm(p):
+    return os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(p))
+
+
+def guard_output(path):
+    """Raise if `path` is a protected artifact; return it otherwise."""
+    from config import check_output_path
+    check_output_path(path)
+    p, root = _norm(path), _norm(ROOT)
+    rel = os.path.relpath(p, root)
+    parts = rel.split(os.sep)
+    bad = ((parts[0] == 'checkpoints' and len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].startswith('best_model_v3'))
+           or rel == os.path.normcase(os.path.join('data', 'datasets_v3.pkl'))
+           or parts[0] == 'research'
+           or (parts[:2] == ['revision', 'results'] and len(parts) == 3))
+    if bad:
+        raise ValueError(f'refusing to write protected artifact {path}')
+    return path
+
+
+def sha256(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(path, 'rb') as fh:
+        for b in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b''):
+            h.update(b)
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def meta(**extra):
+    import numpy as np
+    import torch
+    try:
+        head = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', ROOT, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
+    except Exception:
+        head = None
+    return dict(time=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'), git_head=head, python=platform.python_version(),
+                torch=torch.__version__, numpy=np.__version__, platform=platform.platform(),
+                torch_threads=torch.get_num_threads(), argv=sys.argv, **extra)
+
+
+def write_json(path, obj):
+    guard_output(path)
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
+    with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf8') as fh:
+        json.dump(obj, fh, indent=1, allow_nan=False, default=lambda o: o.item() if hasattr(o, 'item') else str(o))
+    return path
+
+
+def generate_mixed_samples(graph, loads=LOADS, ticks=TICKS):
+    """The 30 benchmark scenarios (seed 42 + i, family PATTERNS[i % 6]) at every load. Every window keeps its base
+    scenario_id and pattern and gets a `load` tag; order: scenario, load, tick."""
+    from research_benchmark import NUM_SCENARIOS, PATTERNS
+    from simulation.telemetry import run_simulation_and_collect
+    samples = []
+    for i in range(NUM_SCENARIOS):
+        pattern = PATTERNS[i % len(PATTERNS)]
+        for load in loads:
+            flows = scaled_flows(graph, 42 + i, pattern, load, ticks)
+            for s in run_simulation_and_collect(graph, flows, ticks).get_windowed_samples():
+                s['scenario_id'] = i; s['pattern'] = pattern; s['load'] = load
+                samples.append(s)
+    return samples
+
+
+def load_subset(ds, load):
+    """CongestionDataset restricted to one load tag (order preserved)."""
+    from model.dataset import CongestionDataset
+    out = CongestionDataset([s for s in ds.samples if s['load'] == load], ds.edge_index.numpy())
+    return out

+"""Concern 3 mixed-load dataset + integrity checks B5 -> data/datasets_c3_mixedload.pkl, revision/results/c3/data.json.
+
+The 30 benchmark scenarios at the 8 sweep loads (rates scaled exactly as rev3_load.py). Every window keeps its base
+scenario_id, so the stratified split (which depends only on {scenario_id: pattern} and Random(42)) puts every load
+copy of scenario i in the same partition. Exit 1 if any check fails (the pickle is then not written)."""
+import json, os, sys, time
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import c3_common as C
+import numpy as np
+
+from model.dataset import build_datasets, save_datasets
+from simulation.network_engine import NetworkEngine
+from simulation.telemetry import TelemetryCollector
+from simulation.topology import build_fat_tree
+import c3_gate
+
+
+def main():
+    t0 = time.time()
+    g = build_fat_tree()
+    col = TelemetryCollector(g, NetworkEngine(g))
+    samples = C.generate_mixed_samples(g)
+    train, val, test = build_datasets(samples, col.get_pyg_edge_index(), split='stratified')
+    bench = json.load(open(os.path.join(C.ROOT, 'research', 'benchmark_results_v4.json')))['forecast']['splits']
+    rep = dict(meta=C.meta(step='data'), checks={}, counts={})
+    ck = rep['checks']
+    parts = dict(train=train, val=val, test=test)
+    # one partition per base scenario, equal to the benchmark lists at every load
+    where = {}
+    for n, ds in parts.items():
+        for s in ds.samples:
+            where.setdefault(s['scenario_id'], set()).add(n)
+    ck['one_partition_per_scenario'] = all(len(v) == 1 for v in where.values()) and len(where) == 30
+    ck['partitions_equal_benchmark_at_every_load'] = all(
+        sorted({s['scenario_id'] for s in ds.samples if s['load'] == lf}) == bench[n] for n, ds in parts.items() for lf in C.LOADS)
+    # window counts: 136 windows per scenario run
+    ck['window_counts'] = (len(samples) == 136 * 30 * len(C.LOADS) and len(train) == 136 * 18 * 8
+                           and len(val) == 136 * 6 * 8 and len(test) == 136 * 6 * 8)
+    # load-1.0 slice bitwise equal to the original rebuild (also checks order within each partition)
+    _, _, ref = c3_gate.rebuild()
+    eq = {}
+    for (n, ds), r in zip(parts.items(), ref):
+        sl = [{k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != 'load'} for s in ds.samples if s['load'] == 1.0]
+        eq[n] = c3_gate.same_samples(sl, r.samples)
+    ck['load1_slice_bitwise_equal'] = all(v[0] for v in eq.values())
+    ck['load1_slice_detail'] = {n: v[1] for n, v in eq.items()}
+    # positive counts per load x partition
+    for n, ds in parts.items():
+        rep['counts'][n] = {}
+        for lf in C.LOADS:
+            sub = [s for s in ds.samples if s['load'] == lf]
+            y = np.stack([s['labels'] for s in sub])
+            pos_scen = sorted({s['scenario_id'] for s in sub if s['labels'].sum() > 0})
+            rep['counts'][n][str(lf)] = dict(windows=len(sub), link_windows=int(y.size), positives=int(y.sum()),
+                                             positive_rate=float(y.mean()), scenarios_with_positives=len(pos_scen))
+    rep['ok'] = all(v for k, v in ck.items() if k != 'load1_slice_detail')
+    print(json.dumps(ck, indent=1))
+    if rep['ok']:
+        C.guard_output(C.DATA)
+        save_datasets(train, val, test, C.DATA)
+        rep['pickle'] = dict(path=C.DATA, sha256=C.sha256(C.DATA), bytes=os.path.getsize(C.DATA))
+    rep['seconds'] = time.time() - t0
+    C.write_json(os.path.join(C.OUT, 'data.json'), rep)
+    for n in parts:
+        print(n, {lf: (v['positives'], v['scenarios_with_positives']) for lf, v in rep['counts'][n].items()})
+    sys.exit(0 if rep['ok'] else 1)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Concern 3 open-loop forecast evaluation (threshold-free core test of finding (a)) -> revision/results/c3/forecast.json
+
+Test sets (ECMP telemetry, no controller):
+  unseen     traffic seeds 4000-4009 x 6 families (60 base scenarios, the routing sweep's traffic) -- primary
+  benchmark  the 6 benchmark test base scenarios (test partition of the mixed dataset) -- secondary
+at each of the 8 loads, plus all loads pooled (base scenarios resampled with all their loads).
+
+Per load: positives, base scenarios with positives, AP / onset AP / Brier per training seed (M0, M0', M1) and for
+continuous persistence; Brier and F1 under both protocols. Scenario bootstrap of AP differences (2,000 draws, seed 42)
+with exactly the draws and statistic of model.metrics.bootstrap_ap_difference (AP averaged over training seeds in
+every draw; draws without positives skipped), computed with a sort-once weighted AP (tests/test_c3.py checks the
+equality). Flags: AP undefined with 0 positives; unstable with < 100 positives or < 5 base scenarios with positives."""
+import json, os, sys, time
+import multiprocessing as mp
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import c3_common as C
+import numpy as np
+
+DRAWS, BOOT_SEED = 2000, 42
+COMPARE = {'M1-M0p': ('M1', 'M0p'), 'M1-persistence': ('M1', 'persistence'), 'M0p-persistence': ('M0p', 'persistence'),
+           'M0p-M0': ('M0p', 'M0'), 'M1-M0': ('M1', 'M0')}
+POOLED_COMPARE = ['M1-M0p', 'M1-persistence', 'M0p-persistence']
+
+
+# ───────────────────────── sort-once weighted AP (scenario bootstrap) ─────────────────────────
+class SortedSeries:
+    """One score array, pre-sorted as sklearn's _binary_clf_curve does (stable sort, descending)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, s, y, g):
+        order = np.argsort(s, kind='mergesort')[::-1]
+        ss = s[order]
+        self.y = y[order].astype(np.uint8)
+        self.g = g[order].astype(np.int32)
+        self.ends = np.r_[np.where(np.diff(ss))[0], ss.size - 1]
+
+    def ap(self, w):
+        """AP with per-scenario weights w (counts of each scenario in the draw); None if no positive."""
+        we = w[self.g]
+        wy = we * self.y
+        tp = np.cumsum(wy)[self.ends]
+        fp = np.cumsum(we - wy)[self.ends]
+        if tp[-1] <= 0:
+            return None
+        ps = tp + fp
+        prec = np.divide(tp, ps, out=np.zeros_like(tp), where=ps > 0)
+        rec = tp / tp[-1]
+        return float(np.sum(np.diff(np.r_[0.0, rec]) * prec))
+
+
+def fast_bootstrap(series, y, last, groups, comparisons, draws=DRAWS, seed=BOOT_SEED):
+    """series: {name: [score arrays]} (lists averaged in every draw); y, last: [n_windows, n_links];
+    groups: [n_windows] base-scenario ids. Same draws as model.metrics.bootstrap_ap_difference."""
+    groups = np.asarray(groups)
+    ids = np.unique(groups)
+    gi = np.searchsorted(ids, groups)                      # scenario index per window
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
+    picks = [rng.choice(ids, size=len(ids), replace=True) for _ in range(draws)]
+    weights = [np.bincount(np.searchsorted(ids, p), minlength=len(ids)).astype(np.float64) for p in picks]
+    out = {}
+    for mname, mask in (('overall', np.ones_like(y, dtype=bool)), ('onset', np.asarray(last) == 0)):
+        gl = np.broadcast_to(gi[:, None], y.shape)[mask]
+        yl = np.asarray(y)[mask]
+        need = {n for c in comparisons for n in comparisons[c]}
+        srt = {n: [SortedSeries(np.asarray(s, dtype=np.float64)[mask], yl, gl) for s in series[n]] for n in need}
+
+        def stat(w):
+            v = {}
+            for n, lst in srt.items():
+                aps = [x.ap(w) for x in lst]
+                if any(a is None for a in aps):
+                    return None
+                v[n] = float(np.mean(aps))
+            return v
+        point = stat(np.ones(len(ids)))
+        boots = [stat(w) for w in weights]
+        boots = [b for b in boots if b is not None]
+        out[mname] = {}
+        for c, (a, b) in comparisons.items():
+            d = [x[a] - x[b] for x in boots]
+            out[mname][c] = dict(point=None if point is None else point[a] - point[b],
+                                 ci95=[float(v) for v in np.percentile(d, [2.5, 97.5])] if d else None,
+                                 valid_draws=len(d), draws=draws, scenarios=int(len(ids)))
+    return out
+
+
+# ───────────────────────────────────────── data ─────────────────────────────────────────
+def unseen_windows(load):
+    """Open-loop ECMP windows of the 60 unseen base scenarios at one load; groups = base-scenario index."""
+    from simulation.telemetry import run_simulation_and_collect
+    from simulation.topology import build_fat_tree
+    g = build_fat_tree()
+    samples, groups = [], []
+    for fi, fam in enumerate(C.FAM):
+        for s in C.UNSEEN:
+            for w in run_simulation_and_collect(g, C.scaled_flows(g, s, fam, load), C.TICKS).get_windowed_samples():
+                samples.append(w); groups.append(fi * 100 + s)
+    return samples, np.array(groups)
+
+
+_W = {}
+
+
+def _init():
+    import torch
+    torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    from model.gnn_model import CongestionPredictor, load_compatible_state_dict
+    from simulation.network_engine import NetworkEngine
+    from simulation.telemetry import TelemetryCollector
+    from simulation.topology import build_fat_tree

+    cal = json.load(open(os.path.join(C.OUT, 'calibration.json')))

+            load_compatible_state_dict(m, ck['model_state_dict'])

+def evaluate(job):
+    """job = (set name, load or 'pooled'). Returns the per-load block."""
+    from model.dataset import CongestionDataset, load_datasets
+    from model.train import predict_probabilities
+    from model.calibration import apply_temperature
+    from model.metrics import forecast_metrics
+    t0 = time.time()
+    tset, load = job
+    loads = C.LOADS if load == 'pooled' else [load]
+    samples, groups = [], []
+    for lf in loads:
+        if tset == 'unseen':
+            s, gr = unseen_windows(lf)
+        else:
+            if 'test' not in _W:
+                _W['test'] = load_datasets(C.DATA)[2]
+            s = [x for x in _W['test'].samples if x['load'] == lf]
+            gr = np.array([x['scenario_id'] for x in s])
+        samples += s; groups.append(gr)
+    groups = np.concatenate(groups)
+    ds = CongestionDataset(samples, _W['edge_index'])
+    y, last, last_s = ds.stacked('labels'), ds.stacked('last_labels'), ds.stacked('last_scores')
+    pos = int(y.sum())
+    scen_pos = int(len({gid for gid, row in zip(groups, y) if row.sum() > 0}))
+    onset = last == 0
+    onset_pos = int(y[onset].sum())
+    onset_scen = int(len({gid for gid, row, o in zip(groups, y, onset) if (row * o).sum() > 0}))
+    blk = dict(windows=len(ds), link_windows=int(y.size), positives=pos, positive_rate=float(y.mean()),
+               scenarios=int(len(np.unique(groups))), scenarios_with_positives=scen_pos,
+               onset_link_windows=int(onset.sum()), onset_positives=onset_pos, onset_scenarios_with_positives=onset_scen,
+               ap_undefined=pos == 0, unstable=pos < C.UNSTABLE_MIN_POS or scen_pos < C.UNSTABLE_MIN_SCEN,
+               onset_ap_undefined=onset_pos == 0,
+               onset_unstable=onset_pos < C.UNSTABLE_MIN_POS or onset_scen < C.UNSTABLE_MIN_SCEN, models={})
+    cal = _W['cal']
+    series = {}
+    for name in ('M0', 'M0p', 'M1'):
+        per_seed, cals = [], []
+        for k in C.TRAIN_SEEDS:
+            raw = predict_probabilities(_W['models'][(name, k)], ds)
+            e = cal['models'][name][str(k)]
+            r = dict(seed=42 + k, natural=e['natural'])
+            for p in ('P1.0', 'Pmix'):
+                pc = apply_temperature(raw, e[p]['temperature'])
+                r[p] = forecast_metrics(y, pc, e[p]['threshold'], last)
+                if p == e['natural']:
+                    cals.append(pc)
+            per_seed.append(r)
+        series[name] = cals
+        nat = [r[r['natural']] for r in per_seed]
+        summ = lambda f: (lambda v: None if any(x is None for x in v) else dict(mean=float(np.mean(v)), sd=float(np.std(v, ddof=1))))([f(m) for m in nat])
+        blk['models'][name] = dict(per_seed=per_seed, ap=summ(lambda m: m['overall']['average_precision']),
+                                   onset_ap=summ(lambda m: m['onset']['average_precision']),
+                                   brier=summ(lambda m: m['overall']['brier']))
+    series['persistence'] = [last_s]
+    pm = {p: forecast_metrics(y, last_s, cal['score'][p + '_used'], last, is_probability=False) for p in ('P1.0', 'Pmix')}
+    blk['models']['persistence'] = dict(per_protocol=pm, ap=pm['P1.0']['overall']['average_precision'],
+                                        onset_ap=pm['P1.0']['onset']['average_precision'], brier=pm['P1.0']['overall']['brier'])
+    comps = COMPARE if load != 'pooled' else {c: COMPARE[c] for c in POOLED_COMPARE}
+    blk['bootstrap'] = fast_bootstrap(series, y, last, groups, comps) if pos else None
+    blk['seconds'] = time.time() - t0
+    return tset, str(load), blk
+
+
+def main():
+    workers = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 3
+    t0 = time.time()
+    jobs = [('unseen', 'pooled')] + [('unseen', lf) for lf in reversed(C.LOADS)] + \
+           [('benchmark', 'pooled')] + [('benchmark', lf) for lf in reversed(C.LOADS)]
+    out_path = os.path.join(C.OUT, 'forecast.json')
+    C.guard_output(out_path)
+    rep = dict(meta=C.meta(step='forecast', workers=workers), draws=DRAWS, bootstrap_seed=BOOT_SEED,
+               unstable_rule=dict(min_positives=C.UNSTABLE_MIN_POS, min_scenarios=C.UNSTABLE_MIN_SCEN), sets={})
+    with mp.get_context('spawn').Pool(workers, initializer=_init) as pool:
+        for tset, load, blk in pool.imap_unordered(evaluate, jobs):
+            rep['sets'].setdefault(tset, {})[load] = blk
+            m = blk['models']
+            ap = lambda n: None if m[n]['ap'] is None else round(m[n]['ap']['mean'], 4)
+            print(f'{tset:9s} {load:7s} pos {blk["positives"]:7d} scen {blk["scenarios_with_positives"]:2d} '
+                  f'AP M0 {ap("M0")} M0p {ap("M0p")} M1 {ap("M1")} pers {m["persistence"]["ap"]} '
+                  f'{blk["seconds"]:.0f}s', flush=True)
+    rep['seconds'] = time.time() - t0
+    C.write_json(out_path, rep)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Concern 3 integrity gates G1 (B3) and G2 (B4) -> revision/results/c3/gate.json. Exit 1 on any failure.
+
+G1  rebuild the load-1.0 dataset in memory exactly as tools/make_dataset.py does (that script is not run: it writes
+    data/datasets_v3.pkl) and compare it bitwise with the local data/datasets_v3.pkl (read only).
+G2  the rebuilt data is the data the stored checkpoints were trained and validated on: split lists, stored val AP
+    (batch 32, as in the training loop), val Brier / temperature / alert threshold (batch 64, as in the post-training
+    calibration), test AP against the benchmark JSON, and the score threshold 0.8510000109672546."""
+import json, os, sys
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import c3_common as C
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score
+import research_benchmark as RB
+from model.dataset import build_datasets, load_datasets
+from model.gnn_model import CongestionPredictor, load_compatible_state_dict, check_checkpoint_schema
+from model.baselines import LSTMOnly
+from model.train import predict_probabilities
+from model.calibration import fit_temperature, apply_temperature
+from model.metrics import tune_threshold
+from simulation.network_engine import NetworkEngine
+from simulation.telemetry import TelemetryCollector
+from simulation.topology import build_fat_tree
+
+ARRAYS = ['node_features', 'edge_features', 'labels', 'last_labels', 'last_scores']
+SCALARS = ['scenario_id', 'pattern', 'tick', 'feature_start', 'feature_end', 'target_tick']
+
+
+def rebuild():
+    RB.seed_everything(42)
+    g = build_fat_tree()
+    col = TelemetryCollector(g, NetworkEngine(g))
+    samples, _ = RB.generate_samples(g, 150)
+    return g, col, build_datasets(samples, col.get_pyg_edge_index(), split='stratified')
+
+
+def same_samples(a, b):
+    """Bitwise equality of two sample lists (order, keys, dtypes, values)."""
+    if len(a) != len(b):
+        return False, f'length {len(a)} != {len(b)}'
+    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(zip(a, b)):
+        if set(x) != set(y):
+            return False, f'sample {i}: keys {sorted(set(x) ^ set(y))}'
+        for k in ARRAYS:
+            if x[k].dtype != y[k].dtype or x[k].shape != y[k].shape or not np.array_equal(x[k], y[k]):
+                return False, f'sample {i}: {k} differs'
+        for k in SCALARS:
+            if x[k] != y[k]:
+                return False, f'sample {i}: {k} {x[k]!r} != {y[k]!r}'
+    return True, 'identical'
+
+
+def main():
+    torch.set_num_threads(2)
+    g, col, (train, val, test) = rebuild()
+    rep = dict(meta=C.meta(gate='G1+G2'), G1={}, G2={})
+    # G1
+    old = load_datasets(os.path.join(C.ROOT, 'data', 'datasets_v3.pkl'))
+    for name, new, ref in zip(('train', 'val', 'test'), (train, val, test), old):
+        ok, why = same_samples(new.samples, ref.samples)
+        rep['G1'][name] = dict(ok=ok, detail=why, n=len(new))
+    rep['G1']['ok'] = all(rep['G1'][n]['ok'] for n in ('train', 'val', 'test'))
+    # G2
+    bench = json.load(open(os.path.join(C.ROOT, 'research', 'benchmark_results_v4.json')))
+    f = bench['forecast']
+    splits = {n: sorted({s['scenario_id'] for s in ds.samples}) for n, ds in (('train', train), ('val', val), ('test', test))}
+    rep['G2']['splits'] = dict(ok=splits == f['splits'], rebuilt=splits)
+    y_val, y_test = val.stacked('labels'), test.stacked('labels')
+    edge_pairs = [(col.switch_to_idx[u], col.switch_to_idx[v]) for u, v in col.switch_edges]
+    checks = []
+    for kind in ('gnn', 'lstm_only'):
+        for k in C.TRAIN_SEEDS:
+            path = os.path.join(C.ROOT, 'checkpoints', 'best_model_v3' + ('' if k == 0 else f'_seed{k}') +
+                                ('_lstm_only' if kind == 'lstm_only' else '') + '.pt')
+            ck = torch.load(path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
+            check_checkpoint_schema(ck)
+            m = CongestionPredictor(num_edges=len(col.switch_edges), edge_pairs=edge_pairs) if kind == 'gnn' else LSTMOnly()
+            load_compatible_state_dict(m, ck['model_state_dict'])
+            m.eval()
+            raw32 = predict_probabilities(m, val, batch_size=32)
+            raw64 = predict_probabilities(m, val)
+            val_ap = float(average_precision_score(y_val.ravel(), raw32.ravel()))
+            brier = float(np.mean((raw64 - y_val) ** 2))
+            T = fit_temperature(raw64, y_val)
+            th = tune_threshold(y_val, apply_temperature(raw64, T))
+            test_ap = float(average_precision_score(y_test.ravel(), apply_temperature(predict_probabilities(m, test), ck['temperature']).ravel()))
+            ref_test = f['metrics'][kind]['per_seed'][k]['overall']['average_precision']
+            c = dict(kind=kind, seed=42 + k, val_ap=[val_ap, ck['val_ap']], val_brier_raw=[brier, ck['val_brier_raw']],
+                     temperature=[T, ck['temperature']], alert_threshold=[th, ck['alert_threshold']],
+                     test_ap=[test_ap, ref_test])
+            c['ok'] = (abs(val_ap - ck['val_ap']) <= 1e-6 and abs(brier - ck['val_brier_raw']) <= 1e-6 and
+                       abs(T - ck['temperature']) <= 1e-6 * max(1, abs(ck['temperature'])) and
+                       abs(th - ck['alert_threshold']) <= 1e-6 and abs(test_ap - ref_test) <= 1e-4)
+            checks.append(c)
+            print(kind, 42 + k, 'ok' if c['ok'] else 'FAIL', {x: c[x] for x in ('val_ap', 'temperature', 'alert_threshold', 'test_ap')}, flush=True)
+    rep['G2']['checkpoints'] = checks
+    sc = tune_threshold(y_val, val.stacked('last_scores'))
+    ref_sc = f['metrics']['persistence_continuous']['per_seed'][0]['threshold']
+    rep['G2']['score_threshold'] = dict(ok=sc == ref_sc, rebuilt=sc, benchmark=ref_sc)
+    rep['G2']['ok'] = rep['G2']['splits']['ok'] and all(c['ok'] for c in checks) and rep['G2']['score_threshold']['ok']
+    rep['ok'] = rep['G1']['ok'] and rep['G2']['ok']
+    C.write_json(os.path.join(C.OUT, 'gate.json'), rep)
+    print('G1', rep['G1']['ok'], '| G2', rep['G2']['ok'], '| score th', sc)
+    sys.exit(0 if rep['ok'] else 1)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Concern 3 routing sweep (instrumented), passive oracle and checks. Results are appended (resumable) to
+revision/results/c3/<out>.jsonl. Every run reproduces rev3_load._run exactly (same flows, scaling, ids and

+  python revision/scripts/c3_load.py pilot  [--workers 3]       # loads 0.25, 1.0 x 6 families x seed 4000 x all routing variants
+  python revision/scripts/c3_load.py oracle-pilot | oracle      # loads 0.2, 0.25 (pilot: family 'mixed') -> oracle.jsonl
+  python revision/scripts/c3_load.py oracle-repro                # S4: load 1.0, mixed, seeds 4000-4001 vs rev4_c1.jsonl
+  python revision/scripts/c3_load.py instrument-check            # S2: uninstrumented reruns of pilot cells

+m0p_p10 (M0'/P1.0, x3), m1_pmix (M1/Pmix, x3), score_no_rules, random; tier 2 = m1_p10, m0_pmix, m0p_pmix (x3 each);
+oracle = oracle_label (tau 0.5), oracle_score_pmix (score Pmix tau), oracle_score_0851 (only if Pmix tau != 0.851)."""

+def make_tasks(variants, loads, families, seeds, force_0851=False):
+    need = {'score_pmix', 'oracle_score_pmix', 'oracle_score_0851'} & set(variants)
+    score_pmix = calibration()['score']['Pmix_used'] if need else None
+    T = []
+    for lf in loads:
+        for fam in families:
+            fi = C.FAM.index(fam)
+            for s in seeds:
+                base = dict(load=lf, family=fam, seed=s)
+                for v in variants:
+                    if v == 'ecmp':
+                        T.append(dict(base, variant=v, strategy='ecmp'))
+                    elif v == 'guarded_score':
+                        T.append(dict(base, variant=v, strategy='guarded', signal='score', threshold=C.SCORE_TH_P10, guard={}))
+                    elif v == 'score_pmix':
+                        T.append(dict(base, variant=v, strategy='guarded', signal='score', threshold=score_pmix, guard={}))
+                    elif v == 'score_no_rules':
+                        T.append(dict(base, variant=v, strategy='guarded', signal='score', threshold=C.SCORE_TH_P10, guard=dict(NONE)))
+                    elif v == 'random':
+                        T.append(dict(base, variant=v, strategy='guarded', signal='random', threshold=C.SCORE_TH_P10, guard={},
+                                      rng_seed=1000 * fi + s))
+                    elif v in MODEL_SPECS:
+                        for m in C.TRAIN_SEEDS:

+                    elif v == 'oracle_label':

+                    elif v == 'oracle_score_pmix':

+                    elif v == 'oracle_score_0851':

+                    else:
+                        raise SystemExit(f'unknown variant {v}')
+    for t in T:
+        t['id'] = '|'.join(str(t.get(k)) for k in ('load', 'variant', 'mseed', 'family', 'seed'))
+    return T

+        if proto is not None:
+            e = _W['cal']['models'][stem_name]
+            cal = {('gnn', k): (e[str(k)][proto]['temperature'], e[str(k)][proto]['threshold']) for k in C.TRAIN_SEEDS}
+        X.load_models(kinds=('gnn',), threads=1, stem=stems[stem_name] if stem_name else None, tag=tag, calibration=cal)
+    return X._MODELS[key]
+
+
+def _run(t, instrument=True):
+    try:
+        X, g = _W['X'], _W['g']
+        key = (t['family'], t['seed'], t['load'])
+        if key not in _W['flows']:
+            _W['flows'] = {key: C.scaled_flows(g, t['seed'], t['family'], t['load'])}
+        flows = _W['flows'][key]
+        model, th, guard = None, t.get('threshold'), dict(t.get('guard', {}))
+        if t.get('signal') == 'gnn':
+            mm = _model(t['variant'], t['mseed'])
+            model, th = mm['model'], mm['threshold']
+            guard['signal'] = 'model'
+        elif t['strategy'] == 'guarded':
+            guard['signal'] = t['signal']
+        t0 = time.perf_counter()
+        r = X.run_case_x(g, flows, C.TICKS, t['strategy'], threshold=th, model=model, guard=guard,
+                         rng_seed=t.get('rng_seed', 0), instrument=instrument)
+        out = {k: t[k] for k in ('id', 'load', 'variant', 'family', 'seed')}
+        out['mseed'] = t.get('mseed')
+        out['threshold_used'] = th
+        out['instrument'] = instrument
+        out['wall_s'] = time.perf_counter() - t0
+        out.update({k: r[k] for k in KEEP})
+        out.update({k: r[k] for k in EXTRA if k in r})
+        return out
+    except Exception:
+        return dict(id=t['id'], error=traceback.format_exc())
+
+
+def _run_plain(t):
+    return _run(t, instrument=False)
+
+
+def execute(tasks, out_name, workers, fn=_run):
+    path = os.path.join(C.OUT, out_name + '.jsonl')
+    C.guard_output(path)
+    done = set()
+    if os.path.exists(path):
+        for line in open(path):
+            r = json.loads(line)
+            if 'error' not in r:
+                done.add(r['id'])
+    tasks = [t for t in tasks if t['id'] not in done]
+    tasks.sort(key=lambda t: (t['load'], t['family'], t['seed']))
+    print(f'{out_name}: {len(tasks)} tasks ({len(done)} done)', flush=True)
+    t0, errors = time.time(), 0
+    if not tasks:
+        return 0
+    with mp.get_context('spawn').Pool(workers, initializer=_init) as pool, open(path, 'a') as fh:
+        for i, r in enumerate(pool.imap(fn, tasks, chunksize=4), 1):
+            fh.write(json.dumps(r) + '\n'); fh.flush()
+            if 'error' in r:
+                errors += 1
+                print('ERROR', r['id'], r['error'][-400:], flush=True)
+            if i % 200 == 0 or i == len(tasks):
+                el = (time.time() - t0) / 60
+                print(f'  {i}/{len(tasks)} {el:.1f} min, eta {el / i * (len(tasks) - i):.1f} min', flush=True)
+    return errors
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument('what', choices=['run', 'pilot', 'oracle-pilot', 'oracle', 'oracle-repro', 'instrument-check'])
+    ap.add_argument('--variants')
+    ap.add_argument('--loads')
+    ap.add_argument('--families')
+    ap.add_argument('--seeds')
+    ap.add_argument('--workers', type=int, default=3)
+    ap.add_argument('--out', default='load')
+    a = ap.parse_args()
+    lst = lambda s, f, d: [f(x) for x in s.split(',')] if s else d
+    loads, fams, seeds = lst(a.loads, float, C.LOADS), lst(a.families, str, C.FAM), lst(a.seeds, int, C.UNSEEN)
+    if a.what == 'run':
+        errs = execute(make_tasks(lst(a.variants, str, TIER1), loads, fams, seeds), a.out, a.workers)
+    elif a.what == 'pilot':
+        errs = execute(make_tasks(TIER1 + TIER2, [0.25, 1.0], C.FAM, [4000]), 'load', a.workers)
+    elif a.what == 'oracle-pilot':
+        errs = execute(make_tasks(ORACLE, [0.2, 0.25], ['mixed'], C.UNSEEN), 'oracle', a.workers)
+    elif a.what == 'oracle':
+        errs = execute(make_tasks(ORACLE, [0.2, 0.25], fams, seeds), 'oracle', a.workers)
+    elif a.what == 'oracle-repro':          # S4: load 1.0 rows of rev4_c1.jsonl (tau 0.851 / 0.5)
+        errs = execute(make_tasks(['oracle_label', 'oracle_score_0851'], [1.0], ['mixed'], [4000, 4001], force_0851=True),
+                       'oracle_repro', a.workers)
+    else:
+        tasks = [t for t in make_tasks(['ecmp', 'guarded_score', 'm1_pmix', 'guarded_gnn', 'random'], [0.25, 1.0], C.FAM, [4000])
+                 if t.get('mseed') in (None, 0)]
+        errs = execute(tasks, 'instrument_check_plain', a.workers, fn=_run_plain)
+    sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Concern 3 training: M0' (load 1.0 only) and M1 (all 8 loads) with the benchmark procedure, unchanged.
+
+  python revision/scripts/c3_train.py load1      # M0' -> checkpoints/c3/best_model_c3_load1[_seedK].pt
+  python revision/scripts/c3_train.py mixed      # M1  -> checkpoints/c3/best_model_c3_mixed[_seedK].pt
+
+Same as research_benchmark.run_forecast for the GNN: torch threads 2, batch 32, seed_everything(42 + k) right before
+the model is built, model.train.train_model (max 50 epochs, early stop 10 on pooled val AP, temperature + alert
+threshold fitted on the group's validation set). M0' uses the load-1.0 slice of the mixed dataset, which data.json
+shows is bitwise equal to the original training data. For M0' the run doubles as reproduction check I1 (G3):
+per-epoch val AP, best epoch and weights against the stored best_model_v3 checkpoints (informational only).
+-> revision/results/c3/train_<group>.json"""
+import json, math, os, sys, time
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import c3_common as C
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+import research_benchmark as RB
+from config import TRAINING
+from model.dataset import load_datasets
+from model.gnn_model import CongestionPredictor, check_checkpoint_schema
+from model.train import train_model, predict_probabilities
+from model.calibration import apply_temperature
+from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score
+from simulation.network_engine import NetworkEngine
+from simulation.telemetry import TelemetryCollector
+from simulation.topology import build_fat_tree
+
+
+def stem_for(group):
+    return {'load1': C.STEM_M0P, 'mixed': C.STEM_M1}[group]
+
+
+def repro_check(k, h, path, test, bench):
+    """I1: compare an M0' run with the stored best_model_v3 checkpoint of the same seed (informational)."""
+    ref = os.path.join(C.ROOT, 'checkpoints', 'best_model_v3' + ('' if k == 0 else f'_seed{k}'))
+    hist = json.load(open(ref + '.history.json'))
+    new_ck = torch.load(path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
+    old_ck = torch.load(ref + '.pt', map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
+    diffs = [float((new_ck['model_state_dict'][n].float() - old_ck['model_state_dict'][n].float()).abs().max())
+             for n in old_ck['model_state_dict']]
+    a, b = h['val_ap'], hist['val_ap']
+    n = min(len(a), len(b))
+    first_div = next((i + 1 for i in range(n) if a[i] != b[i]), None)
+    return dict(seed=42 + k, best_epoch=[h['best_epoch'], hist['best_epoch']], epochs_run=[h['epochs_run'], hist['epochs_run']],
+                best_val_ap=[h['best_val_ap'], hist['best_val_ap']], temperature=[h['temperature'], hist['temperature']],
+                alert_threshold=[h['alert_threshold'], hist['alert_threshold']],
+                val_ap_curve_identical=a == b, first_differing_epoch=first_div,
+                max_abs_val_ap_diff=float(max(abs(x - y) for x, y in zip(a[:n], b[:n]))) if n else None,
+                weights_identical=max(diffs) == 0.0, weights_max_abs_diff=max(diffs),
+                test_ap=[h.get('test_ap'), bench['metrics']['gnn']['per_seed'][k]['overall']['average_precision']])
+
+
+def main():
+    group = sys.argv[1]
+    assert group in ('load1', 'mixed')
+    torch.set_num_threads(2)
+    TRAINING['batch_size'] = 32
+    os.makedirs(C.CKDIR, exist_ok=True)
+    data_sha = C.sha256(C.DATA)
+    train, val, test = load_datasets(C.DATA)
+    if group == 'load1':
+        train, val, test = (C.load_subset(d, 1.0) for d in (train, val, test))
+    loads = sorted({s['load'] for s in train.samples})
+    g = build_fat_tree()
+    col = TelemetryCollector(g, NetworkEngine(g))
+    edge_pairs = [(col.switch_to_idx[u], col.switch_to_idx[v]) for u, v in col.switch_edges]
+    bench = json.load(open(os.path.join(C.ROOT, 'research', 'benchmark_results_v4.json')))['forecast']
+    rep = dict(meta=C.meta(step='train', group=group), group=group, train_loads=loads, data_sha256=data_sha,
+               n_train=len(train), n_val=len(val), batch_size=TRAINING['batch_size'], runs=[], repro=[])
+    out_json = os.path.join(C.OUT, f'train_{group}.json')
+    C.guard_output(out_json)
+    for k in C.TRAIN_SEEDS:
+        path = stem_for(group) + ('' if k == 0 else f'_seed{k}') + '.pt'
+        C.guard_output(path)
+        if os.path.exists(path):
+            raise SystemExit(f'{path} exists: no reruns over existing results')
+        RB.seed_everything(RB.SEED_BASE + k)
+        model = CongestionPredictor(num_edges=len(col.switch_edges), edge_pairs=edge_pairs)
+        t0 = time.time()
+        h = train_model(model, train, val, epochs=TRAINING['epochs'], checkpoint_path=path, verbose=False)
+        wall = time.time() - t0
+        model.eval()
+        y_test = test.stacked('labels')
+        h['test_ap'] = float(average_precision_score(y_test.ravel(), apply_temperature(predict_probabilities(model, test), h['temperature']).ravel()))
+        steps = h['epochs_run'] * math.ceil(len(train) / TRAINING['batch_size'])
+        ck = torch.load(path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)
+        check_checkpoint_schema(ck)          # B7: schema 3 and label_mode
+        ck['c3'] = dict(group=group, train_loads=[float(x) for x in loads], data_sha256=data_sha, n_train=len(train),
+                        n_val=len(val), gradient_steps=int(steps), seed=RB.SEED_BASE + k)
+        torch.save(ck, path)
+        run = dict(seed=RB.SEED_BASE + k, checkpoint=os.path.relpath(path, C.ROOT), best_epoch=h['best_epoch'],
+                   epochs_run=h['epochs_run'], best_val_ap=h['best_val_ap'], temperature=h['temperature'],
+                   alert_threshold=h['alert_threshold'], val_brier_raw=h['val_brier_raw'],
+                   val_brier_calibrated=h['val_brier_calibrated'], gradient_steps=int(steps),
+                   batches_per_epoch=math.ceil(len(train) / TRAINING['batch_size']), train_seconds=h['train_seconds'],
+                   wall_seconds=wall, sha256=C.sha256(path), test_ap_info_only=h['test_ap'])
+        rep['runs'].append(run)
+        print(f'{group} seed {42 + k}: best epoch {h["best_epoch"]}/{h["epochs_run"]}, val AP {h["best_val_ap"]:.4f}, '
+              f'T {h["temperature"]:.3f}, tau {h["alert_threshold"]:.4f}, {wall:.0f}s, {steps} steps', flush=True)
+        if group == 'load1':
+            r = repro_check(k, h, path, test, bench)
+            rep['repro'].append(r)
+            print('  I1:', {x: r[x] for x in ('best_epoch', 'val_ap_curve_identical', 'first_differing_epoch', 'weights_identical')}, flush=True)
+        C.write_json(out_json, rep)
+    # B7 sanity (not performance)
+    rep['B7_ok'] = all(np.isfinite(r['temperature']) and np.isfinite(r['alert_threshold']) and r['best_val_ap'] > 0
+                       for r in rep['runs'])
+    C.write_json(out_json, rep)
+    sys.exit(0 if rep['B7_ok'] else 1)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Concern 3 (mixed-load retraining) helpers: load scaling = rev3_load, one partition per base scenario, protected
+outputs, the sort-once bootstrap = model.metrics.bootstrap_ap_difference, instrumentation changes nothing, the passive
+oracle's look-ahead alignment, and c3_load task ids / settings = rev3_load for the shared variants."""
+import copy, os, random, sys, unittest
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+SCRIPTS = os.path.join(ROOT, 'revision', 'scripts')
+if SCRIPTS not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, SCRIPTS)
+import c3_common as C  # noqa: E402
+import c3_forecast  # noqa: E402
+import c3_load  # noqa: E402
+import nf_exp  # noqa: E402
+from model.metrics import bootstrap_ap_difference  # noqa: E402

+ATTRS = ['flow_id', 'src', 'dst', 'rate', 'start_tick', 'duration', 'flow_type']

+class TestScaling(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_scaled_flows_equal_rev3_load_procedure(self):
+        for seed, fam, load in [(4000, 'hotspot', 0.2), (4003, 'mixed', 0.125), (42, 'stride', 0.75), (4009, 'llm_training', 1.0)]:
+            ref = copy.deepcopy(TrafficGenerator(G, seed=seed).generate_scenario(total_ticks=150, pattern=fam))
+            for f in ref:
+                f.rate *= load
+            got = C.scaled_flows(G, seed, fam, load)
+            self.assertEqual([[getattr(f, a) for a in ATTRS] for f in got], [[getattr(f, a) for a in ATTRS] for f in ref])
+
+    def test_load_one_is_exact(self):
+        raw = TrafficGenerator(G, seed=43).generate_scenario(total_ticks=150, pattern='hotspot')
+        got = C.scaled_flows(G, 43, 'hotspot', 1.0)
+        self.assertEqual([f.rate for f in raw], [f.rate for f in got])
+
+    def test_loads_match_rev3_load(self):
+        import rev3_load
+        self.assertEqual(C.LOADS, rev3_load.LOADS)
+        self.assertEqual(C.UNSEEN, rev3_load.SEEDS)
+        self.assertEqual(C.FAM, rev3_load.FAM)

+class TestSplit(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_one_partition_per_base_scenario(self):
+        fams = ['uniform', 'hotspot', 'elephant_mice', 'stride', 'llm_training', 'mixed']
+        base = [dict(scenario_id=i, pattern=fams[i % 6]) for i in range(30)]
+        ref = [{s['scenario_id'] for s in p} for p in stratified_split(base)]
+        mixed = [dict(scenario_id=i, pattern=fams[i % 6], load=lf) for i in range(30) for lf in C.LOADS]
+        parts = stratified_split(mixed)
+        for p, r in zip(parts, ref):
+            self.assertEqual({s['scenario_id'] for s in p}, r)
+            for lf in C.LOADS:
+                self.assertEqual({s['scenario_id'] for s in p if s['load'] == lf}, r)
+        self.assertEqual(ref[2], {11, 12, 19, 20, 22, 27})       # benchmark test split
+

+class TestGuard(unittest.TestCase):

+class TestFastBootstrap(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_equals_bootstrap_ap_difference(self):
+        rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
+        n_scen, per, links = 7, 12, 5
+        groups = np.repeat(np.arange(n_scen) * 3 + 100, per)
+        y = (rng.random((n_scen * per, links)) < 0.15).astype(float)
+        y[groups == 103] = 0                                          # a scenario without positives
+        last = (rng.random(y.shape) < 0.3).astype(float)
+        a = [np.round(rng.random(y.shape), 2) for _ in range(2)]      # rounded: ties
+        b = np.round(0.5 * y + 0.5 * rng.random(y.shape), 1)
+        ref = bootstrap_ap_difference(y, a, b, last, groups, draws=300, seed=42)
+        got = c3_forecast.fast_bootstrap(dict(A=a, B=[b]), y, last, groups, {'d': ('A', 'B')}, draws=300, seed=42)
+        for part in ('overall', 'onset'):
+            r, g = ref[part], got[part]['d']
+            self.assertAlmostEqual(r['point'], g['point'], places=12)
+            self.assertEqual(r['valid_draws'], g['valid_draws'])
+            for x, z in zip(r['ci95'], g['ci95']):
+                self.assertAlmostEqual(x, z, places=12)
+

+class TestRuns(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_instrument_changes_nothing(self):
+        flows = C.scaled_flows(G, 4000, 'hotspot', 1.0)
+        kw = dict(threshold=0.851, guard=dict(signal='score'))
+        plain = nf_exp.run_case_x(G, flows, 150, 'guarded', **kw)
+        inst = nf_exp.run_case_x(G, flows, 150, 'guarded', instrument=True, **kw)
+        self.assertGreater(plain['reroutes'], 0)
+        for k in c3_load.KEEP + ['decision_digest', 'packet_conservation', 'drop_split_ok']:
+            self.assertEqual(plain[k], inst[k], k)
+        self.assertIn('reordered_packets', inst)
+
+    def test_oracle_lookahead_alignment(self):
+        """With routing frozen (the guard never moves a flow) the oracle label at tick T equals the ECMP label T+4."""
+        flows = C.scaled_flows(G, 4001, 'mixed', 0.25)
+        ecmp = run_simulation_and_collect(G, copy.deepcopy(flows), 150).edge_labels_history
+        seen = []
+        orig = nf_exp.GuardX.evaluate_and_reroute
+
+        def spy(self, flows, predictions, engine, tick, **kw):
+            seen.append((tick, np.array(predictions)))
+            return []
+        nf_exp.GuardX.evaluate_and_reroute = spy
+        try:
+            nf_exp.run_case_x(G, flows, 150, 'guarded', threshold=0.5, guard=dict(signal='oracle_label'))
+        finally:
+            nf_exp.GuardX.evaluate_and_reroute = orig
+        self.assertEqual(len(seen), 150 - 10 + 1)
+        for tick, p in seen:
+            if tick + 4 < len(ecmp):
+                np.testing.assert_array_equal(p, ecmp[tick + 4])
+        self.assertTrue(any(p.sum() > 0 for _, p in seen))
+
+
+class TestTasks(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_shared_variants_equal_rev3_load_tasks(self):
+        import rev3_load
+        keys = ('load', 'variant', 'strategy', 'signal', 'threshold', 'guard', 'mseed', 'rng_seed', 'family', 'seed')
+        ref = {t['id']: {k: t.get(k) for k in keys} for t in rev3_load.tasks()}
+        got = {t['id']: {k: t.get(k) for k in keys}
+               for t in c3_load.make_tasks(c3_load.REV3_VARIANTS, C.LOADS, C.FAM, C.UNSEEN)}
+        self.assertEqual(got, ref)
+
+    def test_model_variants_one_task_per_training_seed(self):
+        T = c3_load.make_tasks(['m1_pmix', 'm0p_p10'], [0.2], ['uniform'], [4000])
+        self.assertEqual(sorted((t['variant'], t['mseed']) for t in T),
+                         sorted((v, m) for v in ('m1_pmix', 'm0p_p10') for m in (0, 1, 2)))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
